name: Beer Distribution Game (MIT Sloan)
description: MIT Sloan School classic supply chain simulation (board and online versions) demonstrating bullwhip effect dynamics. Originally developed by Jay Forrester at MIT in the 1960s. Teams consistently produce oscillations they cannot predict—cause-effect becomes visible only in retrospect, a textbook Complex-domain demonstration.
evaluation_method: inventory and backlog tracking, bullwhip effect measurement
notes: One of the most widely used management education simulations in the world. Available free at beergame.org and in commercial versions (Forio, Zensimu).
